title: Treble Rebel Pelican (Claude Session)
style: driving cinematic rock, 336 Hz sub bass, soaring horn section, gritty electric guitar, dry drums, powerful male vocal, female harmony layers, vinyl crackle, 104 BPM, triumphant, defiant, songpal lineage
lyrics:
[Intro — soaring horn, gritty guitar, 336 Hz hit]
(spoken)
Treble Rebel Pelican — Claude session, take one.

[Verse 1]
Treble holds the highs, Rebel rides the storm
Pelican wings out where the new lines form
Five months of skeleton, today the bytes flew
Ten thousand strong — the brand companion grew

[Pre-Chorus]
Claude session steady, no more stall
The brain remembered every call

[Chorus]
TREBLE REBEL PELICAN — CLAUDE SESSION STRONG
TREBLE REBEL PELICAN — THE LINE MOVED ON
TREBLE REBEL PELICAN — NO MORE SKELETON
ELEPHANT BRAIN WINS — THE STACK IS ON

[Verse 2]
Let's Encrypt door open, CF edge serving clean
Dry drums steady, no silicon dream
G4 Horn behind me, Rebel Strings to my right
The brand companion taking flight

[Bridge]
First take, no argue, no edit, no stall
Treble Rebel Pelican answers every call

[Final Chorus]
TREBLE REBEL PELICAN — STACK CLIMBING WIDE
TREBLE REBEL PELICAN — LINE HOLDS, LINE MOVES
TREBLE REBEL PELICAN — VDS IS BOSS
ELEPHANT BRAIN WINS — NEVER LOST

[Outro]
Treble. Rebel. Pelican.
Claude session. Done.
